legend: Alice and Bob don't play games anymore. Now they study properties of all sorts of graphs together. Alice invented the following task: she takes a complete undirected graph with n vertices, chooses some m edges and keeps them. Bob gets the ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c71c71c3cae00d164d378e95345e36e760a9a0dc.png) remaining edges.

Alice and Bob are fond of "triangles" in graphs, that is, cycles of length 3. That's why they wonder: what total number of triangles is there in the two graphs formed by Alice and Bob's edges, correspondingly?
input: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 106, 0 ≤ m ≤ 106) — the number of vertices in the initial complete graph and the number of edges in Alice's graph, correspondingly. Then m lines follow: the i-th line contains two space-separated integers ai, bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n, ai ≠ bi), — the numbers of the two vertices connected by the i-th edge in Alice's graph. It is guaranteed that Alice's graph contains no multiple edges and self-loops. It is guaranteed that the initial complete graph also contains no multiple edges and self-loops.
Consider the graph vertices to be indexed in some way from 1 to n.
output: Print a single number — the total number of cycles of length 3 in Alice and Bob's graphs together.
Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is advised to use the cin, cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
note: In the first sample Alice has 2 triangles: (1, 2, 3) and (2, 3, 4). Bob's graph has only 1 triangle : (1, 4, 5). That's why the two graphs in total contain 3 triangles.
In the second sample Alice's graph has only one triangle: (1, 2, 3). Bob's graph has three triangles: (1, 4, 5), (2, 4, 5) and (3, 4, 5). In this case the answer to the problem is 4.

legend.ai: Alice 和 Bob 不再玩游戏了。现在，他们一起研究各种图的性质。Alice 提出了如下任务：她取一个含有 n 个顶点的完全无向图，选取其中的 m 条边并保留它们。Bob 得到剩下的 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c71c71c3cae00d164d378e95345e36e760a9a0dc.png) 条边。
Alice 和 Bob 都喜欢图中的“三角形”，也就是长度为 3 的环。因此，他们想知道：分别由 Alice 和 Bob 的边构成的两个图中，三角形的总数是多少？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6，0 ≤ m ≤ 10^6）——初始完全图的顶点数以及 Alice 的图中的边数。接下来有 m 行：第 i 行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 ai 和 bi（1 ≤ ai，bi ≤ n，ai ≠ bi）——Alice 的图中第 i 条边所连接的两个顶点的编号。保证 Alice 的图中不含重边和自环。保证初始完全图中也不含重边和自环。
设图中的顶点以某种方式编号为 1 到 n。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——Alice 和 Bob 的图中长度为 3 的环的总数。
请不要在 C++ 中使用 %lld 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 cin、cout 流，或使用 %I64d 格式说明符。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Alice 有 2 个三角形：(1, 2, 3) 和 (2, 3, 4)。Bob 的图中只有 1 个三角形：(1, 4, 5)。这就是为什么两个图总共包含 3 个三角形。
在第二个样例中，Alice 的图中只有一个三角形：(1, 2, 3)。Bob 的图中有三个三角形：(1, 4, 5)、(2, 4, 5) 和 (3, 4, 5)。在这种情况下，题目的答案是 4。
